source.original_title: 06/09/2026 - Badrane Hriouch x Harry Edmonds KL
source.display_title: 06/09/2026 - Badrane Hriouch x Harry Edmonds KL — Lost

setter.name: Kyla
setter.evidence: I know you spoke with Kyla. She told me you're pretty straight to the point guy

prospect.name: Badrane Hriouch
prospect.training_background: Muay Thai, kickboxing, Jiu Jitsu, kitesurfing. Anti-barbell.

signals: Anchors on a $29/mo coach he used for 18 months
Self-describes as 'a salesman by nature' and pre-frames his own close resistance
Highly self-directed: 'I don't need somebody to get me out of bed'
Explicitly price-conditional: 'if it makes sense for me, it makes sense'

goals.text: Gain ~5 lb of muscle this year, reach 80-85 kg long term
Lose belly fat from late-night eating
Avoid future injuries; save research time

pains.text: Chronic wrist injuries (both, 5-6 years) limiting training
Elbow, shoulder, knee, ankle injuries; flat foot
Feels stiff and injury-prone with conventional weight training

objections.raw_quote: 6K? Yeah, it's a big difference from 29 bucks a month to 6K.
objections.rep_response: Which is why I was saying to you, dude, go back to her.

objections.raw_quote: honestly, if it's like $200 a month, whatever, for a year or whatever, I like to do memberships for a long term
objections.rep_response: Explained the 3-pillar offer + 24/7 support + 20lb kettlebell guarantee

objections.raw_quote: what type of customers you're dealing with? Because I think you're dealing with the different customers than mine
objections.rep_response: Described ICP: successful business owners/physicians going from good to great

evidence: '6k, it's a little more than what I want to spend, so, yeah, thank you so much'
Prospect ends the call himself: 'cheers, see you soon, bye'
No next step, no follow-up booked, no payment link sent

notable.note: Rep twice told the prospect to go back to his $29/mo coach. Read as a deliberate takeaway, but no payment plan or downsell was ever offered before the call ended.

quality.notes: At ~00:03:00 the rep's question 'and do you do kettlebells now' is merged into the prospect's turn. Attribution of individual lines is unreliable; objection quotes were verified by context.
